notes: receiptVectors: receiptJson (UTF-8 text) or receiptBase64 are the signed bytes, run through the DISPATCHING validator (v3 when the bytes claim "v":3, otherwise v2) with the same context shape as test-vectors.json.
The v3 validator does not compare policyVersion with anything (expected.policyVersion is ignored); basis "policy" is refused for every action outside the policy-skippable set with code basis_action.

policyVectors: parse json with the strict reader (depth 2) as a tier policy. ok:false means rejected; otherwise canonicalJson is the compact file form, hash the policy hash (a receipt v3 policyVersion), noPrompt the actions that need no person.
loosenVectors: loosens is true when moving from one policy to the other lets an action skip a person that could not skip before (that is what needs a presence signature).
Both the Node and C# implementations must reproduce every expected value. The policy hash and message are defined in TierPolicy.cs.
